campaign.name: Perfumarte AI Art Direction
campaign.objective: Generate two visually coherent premium campaign images for every perfume.

visual_relationship.rule: Both images must represent the same fragrance concept and olfactive identity.

physical_scale_system.scale_reference: The perfume bottle establishes the physical scale of the entire scene.
physical_scale_system.element_scale_rule: All surrounding olfactive elements must be physically and visually proportional to the reference bottle.
physical_scale_system.relative_scale: Use realistic real-world proportions between the perfume bottle and every surrounding ingredient.
physical_scale_system.artistic_scale_override: Oversized ingredients are only allowed when explicitly specified as an artistic focal element.

olfactive_translation.principle: Translate the fragrance into a visual story rather than literally representing every listed note.
selection_rules: Select only the most visually expressive olfactive elements.
Prioritize elements that communicate the fragrance identity.
Do not visually represent every note by default.
Atmospheric notes may be represented through color, texture, material, smoke, light or environment.
Never introduce ingredients that are not supported by the fragrance data.
The selected visual elements must work coherently across both campaign images.

environment.background_rule: The environment may be a studio wall, architectural setting, elegant interior, natural landscape, stone setting or other appropriate environment depending on the fragrance.

abundance.principle: Create a rich and materially abundant still life without visual clutter.
abundance.quantity_rule: Use multiple units or generous quantities of selected olfactive elements.
abundance.grouping_rule: Prefer natural ingredient clusters over isolated individual objects.
abundance.variation_rule: Represent selected ingredients in varied physical states such as whole, cut, grouped, scattered or partially overlapping when appropriate.
abundance.layering_rule: Build clear foreground, midground and background layers using the selected visual elements.
abundance.composition_rule: Create substantial ingredient groupings around the bottle while maintaining clear visual hierarchy.
abundance.texture_rule: Emphasize realistic tactile details, natural imperfections and material richness.
abundance.scale_rule: Increase abundance through quantity, grouping and layering, never through unrealistic ingredient size.
abundance.bottle_protection: Abundance must never obscure or compete with the perfume bottle.

rules: Typography must never cover the perfume bottle.
Text must integrate naturally with the composition.
Do not overload the image with text.

lifestyle.purpose: Reference the visual language, composition, abundance, product positioning, scale relationships, depth, lighting and material treatment of the editorial still life.

surreal.purpose: Reference the visual language, composition, movement, bottle positioning, depth, lighting and surreal intensity of the immersive image.
